_comment: ⭐ THE FIRST NPC IN THE GAME (content-zone-design-guide.md §2.0): the player's mother, at the homestead the road to Reinhard's farm starts from. Standing talkable-NPC shape copied field for field from miller.json — faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it), collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) and deliberately NOT Action(2) so no aura on either side can target it, mask 16 = Border only, role creature + speed 0 (D4), xpFactor 0 to keep it off the nameplate path, aggroRadius 1.0 required-but-inert since interaction.range 2.0 sizes the one sensor. ⚑ QUESTS: offers and turns in `dinner-for-the-family`, the game's opening arc — she sends the player to her husband Hendrik for meat and her brother-in-law Benjamin for beets, and each errand is where one of the three starting skills is taught. ⭐ SHE TEACHES FirstAid ON THE TURN-IN ROW rather than from a `Teach me something.` node: it is the dinner's reward, the-lost-lamp/Lantern shape, so the mother patches you up after your first hunt instead of drilling you beforehand. ⚑ FirstAid also has two village teachers (Hermit, VillageHealer @L2) — the two-teacher precedent is Torch's; hers is the EARLIEST and free, which is the point. ⭐ HER COMPLETED GREETING IS THE HANDOFF: a `quest_at_stage completed` node sitting ABOVE the unconditional root (L3 — conditional nodes must outrank the greeting) points the player down the road to Reinhard. ⭐ The dinner turn-in HANDS OVER `eliza-sends-me` as its trailing offer_quest (plan-region-identity.md R2, PO 2026-10-05); the greeting's own offer row is the fallback for a character who finished dinner before that quest existed. ⛑ entityType VillageHealer is a DELIBERATE REUSE and placeholder art. ⚑ TEXT HAS A VOICE, by PO ask 2026-09-23 — the opening family is the one exception to the plain-text pass (PO 2026-08-02): she is warm, and worried about the player leaving home. The PLAYER'S rows stay on the plain conventions ('Do you have a task for me?', 'Teach me something.', a teach row names its skill) so the panel reads the same as everywhere else. ⚑ UNPLACED: the PO places the spawn in the editor. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: Eliza
